photoTips.title: Better prompts for unlimited-style image generation
photoTips.subtitle: A strong unrestricted or unlimited-style prompt is specific, original, and bounded. These habits improve output quality without relying on risky wording.

items.title: Define the subject
items.desc: Name the original subject, setting, pose, visual era, and output purpose before adding style words.

items.title: Control composition
items.desc: Specify camera angle, framing, aspect ratio, focal length feel, background density, and text placement.

items.title: Protect identity and permissions
items.desc: Use your own images or licensed references, and avoid private people, minors, impersonation, or deceptive edits.

items.title: Replace weak negatives
items.desc: Instead of asking for forbidden content, describe the allowed final result clearly and state what should remain non-explicit, original, or brand-free.

faq.q: What is an unrestricted or unlimited AI image generator?
faq.a: It is an image generator built for broader creative prompts, stronger style control, and fewer unnecessary generic rewrites. On Toolaze, unlimited-style generation still uses clear creative boundaries and permission-based use.

faq.q: Is Toolaze a no-restriction AI image generator?
faq.a: Toolaze supports broader original concepts and fewer rigid prompt rewrites, but it is not literally unlimited and does not remove safety rules. It keeps boundaries around illegal, non-consensual, minor-related, impersonation, explicit, or harmful misuse.
The generator opens with Wan 2.7 Image selected by default. You can switch models from the generator panel when another option better matches the style, speed, or output you need.
Toolaze access can vary by account status, model availability, credits, and selected settings. Check the generator panel for the current free trial or credit requirement before generation.

faq.q: How do I get better results?
faq.a: Write specific prompts with subject, style, lighting, camera, composition, output format, and safe-use boundaries. If the result drifts, add reference images or clarify what must stay unchanged.

faq.q: What aspect ratio should I choose?
faq.a: Use 16:9 for cinematic banners and wide scenes, 1:1 for square social posts, and vertical ratios for portraits or mobile-first images.
